choice_policy: Choose one setting once per episode as COPY_LIMITS[seed % 2]; two consecutive seeds cover both settings.
invariant_reasoning: find blue edge markers and infer direction
preserve that frame's color and move in 4-cell steps
lesson_policy: Three labeled demonstrations plus one unlabeled query; evaluate all four single-query rotations against the other setting.
limitations: Only two bounded settings are evaluated.
Finite generated episodes refute only the declared parameter rival.
The alternative is proposed evidence, not a production API or approval.
Inputs intentionally avoid chain collisions, matching the selected domain.

copy_limit.input_constraints: Every marker must identify one frame and have room for one full copy; retained episode inputs also have room for at least two copies so the settings visibly disagree.
copy_limit.meaning: Number of translated frame copies emitted per edge marker: repeat to the edge or stop after the first copy.

scope: Proposed task-local parametric extension only; it does not alter or approve the selected canonical rule or production generator.
